interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through loading fit statistics and comparing nested models.
Explain the F-test, confidence threshold and chi-square upper limit.

interactive.label: chi2_1
interactive.tooltip: Reduced χ² of the first (simpler) model.

interactive.label: n1
interactive.tooltip: Degrees of freedom of the first model.

interactive.label: chi2_2
interactive.tooltip: Reduced χ² of the second (more complex) model; recomputed when the confidence changes.

interactive.label: n2
interactive.tooltip: Degrees of freedom of the second model (points minus free parameters).

interactive.label: conf_level
interactive.tooltip: F-test confidence level; recomputed from the χ² ratio, or drives the χ²(2) threshold when edited.

interactive.label: npars
interactive.tooltip: Number of free parameters of the model.

interactive.label: conf_level_2
interactive.tooltip: Confidence level for the χ² upper limit.

interactive.label: chi2_max
interactive.tooltip: Resulting χ² upper limit at the chosen confidence level.
